item.title: Tensions Rise! Iran Says It Hit a US Radar in Bahrain
item.description:
⚠️ Iran Says It Hit a US Radar in Bahrain
Iran's Revolutionary Guards (IRGC) said on Friday that they targeted and destroyed a US early-warning radar in Bahrain. Iran's state news agency IRNA reported the statement. AP and Al Jazeera said the claim could not be independently verified, and the US and Bahrain did not comment straight away.
🔹 The IRGC said it was a reply to an attack on a telecom tower in Sirik, a port city in southern Iran, on Thursday. 🔹 According to Reuters, it is Iran's first claimed attack on US military assets in a Gulf country since early September. 🔹 Bahrain hosts the headquarters of the US Navy's Fifth Fleet. The IRGC warned it is ready to act again.
💬 Do you think talks can stop the tension from growing? 👇
Sources: AP, Al Jazeera, Reuters

item.title: Global Outage! Microsoft Outlook and Teams Go Down for 5+ Hours
item.description:
💻 Microsoft Outlook and Teams down for hours
A major Microsoft 365 outage disrupted Outlook email, Teams and other Microsoft services for more than five hours on Thursday, Reuters reported. Problems began around 12:30 p.m. US Eastern time, and Microsoft said users in any region could be affected.
🔹 Problem reports for Outlook on Downdetector peaked at more than 138,000, according to Reuters. 🔹 Microsoft said a number of servers became unexpectedly unavailable because of elevated load, mainly hitting Exchange Online email. 🔹 Microsoft said it was returning servers to service and moving traffic, and warned that recovery would be gradual as users reconnect.
💬 Were you affected by the Microsoft outage? 👇
Sources: Reuters, ABC News
